name: Goods / Products
description: Vendors supplying physical products, materials, equipment or inventory. Adds product-liability and quality evidence, and asks for an MSME registration where the vendor claims one.

fields.label: Nature of goods supplied
fields.why: Determines whether product certifications or import licences apply to you.

fields.label: HSN / commodity codes
fields.why: Lets us match your invoices to the right tax treatment automatically.

fields.label: Udyam / MSME registration number
fields.why: MSME vendors are entitled to statutory payment terms, so we record this to make sure you are paid on time.

documents.label: Product / quality certification
documents.why: Regulated or safety-critical goods need certification before we can raise a purchase order.
documents.expects: A quality or product-conformance certificate naming the supplier or the product line

documents.label: Udyam / MSME certificate
documents.why: Confirms the MSME registration number you provided.
documents.expects: A Udyam registration certificate showing the registration number and enterprise name

documents.label: Product liability insurance
documents.why: Speeds up approval for high-value orders; not required to onboard.
documents.expects: A current liability insurance certificate naming the business
